what: A timber-framed Starfall cottage: stone plinth, plaster walls, steep tiled roof with chimney, door and two windows, seen from the isometric overworld camera.

dims.basis: ART_DIRECTION house ~3.0u high, 1 tile = 1u so a 2x2-tile footprint with 0.15u roof overhang

views.why: commander camera sees the roof and the front facade at 45/30 degrees

style_notes: Low-poly diorama: wood #6B4423, stone #7A7F87, plaster #D9B46A-tinted pale, roof dark slate from palette steel, glass #3A7CA5, gold #D9A62E handle. No textures. Never: flat roof, unreadable windows, invented hues, stacked boxes without bevels.
notes: Replaces the 236-tri old house with pitched gables, shingled roof, timber frame, framed windows and a chimney, within the 1500-tri assembled budget.
